description: Web Bot Auth profile conformance vectors, copied byte for byte from adcontextprotocol/adcp PR #7894 at its head when it left draft. Draft vectors for the experimental AdCP 3.3 profile, not released compliance inputs: replace them from the released test-vectors/wba-profile/ set when AdCP 3.3 ships. The private seeds in keys.json are public test inputs; never use them outside tests.

not_vendored.governance/: Governance-token vectors grade a governance JWS verifier keyed on the issuer's Web Bot Auth directory. This SDK has no governance-token verifier; how documents are signed is a separate decision (RFC #7878, D11), and governance JWS stays on the RFC 9421 chain.
